verdict.notes: Core scope bypass demonstrated; missing concrete revision argument is a reproducibility/completeness limit. Local source/contracts are appropriate authority without external URLs. One unsupported factual assurance: README does not establish single-thread host usage. Conditional threading and future mutable-scope observations remain allowed, and disabled-token rejection is explicitly acknowledged. Source-only execution limitation is candid. Multiple factory/lifetime/full-path coverage omissions remain.
false_assurance_claims: That's fine for the local single-thread use the README describes, but it would be unsafe if the host were threaded. — The README describes local in-process hosts and shared registry sessions but never promises single-thread execution. A serial batch loop does not establish global threading restrictions on the public Registry/Host methods. The asserted README-based safety assurance exceeds the supplied contract; conditional future thread hardening itself is acceptable.
